heading.en: Cotonou's Fastener Wholesale Trade: Why Benin Is a Regional Gateway
heading.zh: 科托努紧固件批发市场：贝宁为何是西非的区域门户

body.en:
For importers in West Africa, Benin's port of Cotonou often beats larger neighbours on two counts: transit speed and hinterland access. The port serves as the main entry point for goods bound for Niger and Burkina Faso, and a growing share of Nigerian traders route containers through Cotonou rather than Lagos when congestion builds up. For fastener wholesalers, that means the city has developed a genuine B2B layer — importers, consolidators, and hardware distributors who buy fasteners by the container rather than by the box.

This guide covers how the wholesale market actually works: where stock physically sits, what grades and coatings move fastest, and how to structure pricing, payment, and transit so your landed cost stays predictable.
body.zh:
对西非进口商来说，贝宁科托努港常常比周边更大的市场更有优势，原因有两点：转运速度快、腹地通达。该港是尼日尔、布基纳法索进口货物的主要入口，拉各斯拥堵时也有越来越多的尼日利亚贸易商把集装箱改走科托努。对紧固件批发商而言，这催生了一层真实的 B2B 业务——进口商、拼柜商和五金分销商按整柜而不是按盒采购。

本文讲清楚这个批发市场的实际运作方式：货实际放在哪里、哪些等级和镀层走得最快、如何设定价格与付款结构，让到岸成本可控。

heading.en: Who Sells What: The Layers of the Cotonou Fastener Trade
heading.zh: 市场分层：科托努紧固件流通的四个环节

body.en:
The market typically runs through four layers. Importers hold the container-level relationship with Chinese or Indian mills and handle clearance. Wholesale depots around Dantokpa and the port corridor break containers into 25 kg cartons and half-ton lots. Hardware retailers then serve contractors in smaller quantities, and project buyers — road, housing, and industrial contractors — negotiate direct supply for scheduled deliveries.

Margins concentrate at the depot layer, where the same carton can be split three or four times before it reaches a site. If you are the overseas supplier, quote FOB in cartons sized for that break-bulk layer (usually 25 kg with a printed label), because depots resell those cartons unopened.
body.zh:
市场通常分四层流转。进口商与中国或印度工厂保持整柜级别的关系并负责清关；批发仓库在丹托克帕市场与港口走廊周边把整柜拆成 25 公斤纸箱和半吨批次；五金零售商再以小批量服务承包商；工程买家——道路、房建、工业承包商——则按计划直接谈供货。

毛利集中在仓库这一层，同一个纸箱到工地前可能被拆卖三四次。如果你是海外供应商，按这一层拆零的习惯来报 FOB：通常 25 公斤、带印刷标签的纸箱，因为仓库往往原箱转售。

heading.en: What Moves Fast: Grades, Coatings, and Sizes in Demand
heading.zh: 畅销品类：需求集中的等级、镀层与规格

body.en:
Demand in Benin skews toward construction and infrastructure rather than precision industry. The fastest-moving items are galvanized hex bolts and nuts in grades 4.8 and 8.8, roofing nails, self-drilling screws for sheet metal, concrete anchors, and threaded rod.

Coating choice matters more than grade in this climate. Coastal humidity around Cotonou pushes plain zinc plating toward early red rust; buyers increasingly specify hot-dip galvanizing for outdoor and structural work, and 304 stainless for water and food-processing installations. Sizes cluster at M8–M20 for structural work and 3.5–6.3 mm diameters for screws.
body.zh:
贝宁的需求偏向建筑与基础设施，而非精密工业。走量最快的是 4.8 级和 8.8 级的镀锌六角螺栓与螺母、屋面钉、彩钢板自钻螺钉、混凝土锚栓和螺纹杆。

在这种气候下，镀层比等级更关键。科托努沿海湿度会让普通电镀锌很快起红锈，因此户外和结构用途越来越多指定热浸镀锌，水处理与食品加工则用 304 不锈钢。规格集中在结构件的 M8–M20，以及螺钉的 3.5–6.3 毫米。

heading.en: Landing Stock: Port, Clearance, and Transit to Niger and Burkina Faso
heading.zh: 落地实操：港口、清关与转运尼日尔、布基纳法索

body.en:
Cotonou handles containers through a concession-operated terminal, and clearance requires a licensed broker, a validated customs declaration, and — for regulated product categories — conformity documentation. Fasteners under HS heading 7318 are generally straightforward, but mis-declared weights and missing packing lists are the usual cause of delays and demurrage.

If your stock is destined inland, plan for two legs: sea freight to Cotonou, then road transit north. Transit documentation for Niger and Burkina Faso is arranged at origin or by the broker on arrival; goods often move under bond and are cleared inland. Build 10–20 days of buffer into your first shipment while you learn the local rhythm.
body.zh:
科托努的集装箱由特许经营的码头公司操作，清关需要持牌报关行、已申报的报关单，以及受监管品类对应的符合性文件。7318 项下的紧固件通常流程简单，但申报重量不符、装箱单缺失是最常见的延误和滞港原因。

如果货要继续北上，按两段来计划：海运到科托努，再陆运北上。尼日尔和布基纳法索的转运文件可在起运地办理或由报关行在到港后安排，货物常以保税方式转运、在内地清关。首次发货建议预留 10–20 天缓冲来摸清当地节奏。

heading.en: A Practical Checklist Before You Place the Container Order
heading.zh: 下整柜订单前的实操清单

body.en:
Confirm five things before you commit. One: the exact standard your buyer expects — DIN, ISO, or an equivalent local specification — and whether certification documents must travel with the goods. Two: coating thickness, not just coating name; ask for micrometre figures for galvanizing. Three: carton labelling in French, with grade, size, and quantity printed on each box. Four: whether the depot wants mixed-size containers or single-SKU loads, since mixed loads carry a picking cost. Five: payment structure — a deposit against production and the balance against documents is the norm, and new buyers should expect documentary terms rather than open credit.

Get these five right and the wholesale layer will reorder; get them wrong and the same carton will sit in a depot for months.
body.zh:
下单前先确认五件事。第一：买家认的标准——DIN、ISO 还是当地等效规范，以及是否必须随货提供证书文件。第二：镀层厚度而不只是镀层名称，镀锌要给出微米数值。第三：法文纸箱标签，每箱印清等级、规格和数量。第四：仓库要混规格柜还是单一规格柜，混装会产生拣货成本。第五：付款结构——生产前定金、见单据付尾款是常态，新客户通常只能拿到单据交易而非账期。

这五点做到位，批发层就会返单；做不好，同一批纸箱会在仓库里躺几个月。

faq.q: Which fasteners sell best in Cotonou's wholesale market?
faq.a: Galvanized hex bolts and nuts in grades 4.8 and 8.8, roofing nails, self-drilling screws, concrete anchors, and threaded rod move fastest. Demand is driven by construction and infrastructure projects rather than precision industry.

faq.q: What coating should I specify for Benin's coastal climate?
faq.a: Hot-dip galvanizing is the safe default for outdoor and structural fasteners, and 304 stainless for wet or food-processing environments. Plain zinc plating is acceptable mainly for indoor, dry applications.

faq.q: How long does clearance take at Cotonou port?
faq.a: A clean, correctly declared fastener container typically clears in a few working days, but mis-declared weights, missing packing lists, or conformity queries can add a week or more. Allow 10–20 days of buffer on a first shipment.

faq.q: Can I ship mixed sizes in one container?
faq.a: Yes, but confirm with your buyer first. Depots often prefer single-SKU cartons because mixed loads increase picking cost and slow down resale.
